greet.title: Principal's Welcome
greet.text: Welcome to SMK Telkom Malang. We are committed to equipping every student with digital skills, strong character, and a global outlook so they are ready for careers or further study. Grow with us.

abt.title: A Digital School That Prepares You to Be Global Talent
abt.text: SMK Telkom Malang is a vocational school under the Telkom Education Foundation, focused on digital talent. You learn with current technology, train alongside industry partners, and build the strong character to be ready for work, further study, or entrepreneurship.

jrn.title: Your Journey at SMK Telkom
jrn.sub: From your first day of applying to being ready for the workplace and further education.

s1.d: Apply through admissions and choose the major that fits your interests.

s2.d: Master theory and practice through technology-driven learning.

s3.d: Join the Digital Talent Program and collaborate with industry partners.

s4.d: Graduate ready to work, study, or start a business, backed by the alumni network.

prof.title: Get to Know SMK Telkom Malang
prof.p1: SMK Telkom Malang is a vocational school under the Telkom Education Foundation that produces industry-ready and world-ready digital talent. We combine technology-driven learning, laboratory practice, and collaboration with industry partners.
prof.p2: As part of the Telkom education network, our school keeps growing, offering majors relevant to the needs of the digital workplace, from the Digital Talent Program to the International Class.

vm.title: Our Direction and Goals
vm.visi_text: To be an excellent digital vocational school that produces talent with character, global competitiveness, and industry readiness.
vm.m1: Deliver technology-driven learning that meets industry needs.
vm.m2: Develop expertise through practice, certification, and partnerships with industry.
vm.m3: Shape students who are disciplined, principled, and collaborative.
vm.m4: Broaden global perspective through international programs and the alumni network.

val.title: The Values We Stand For
val.sub: The principles that shape how we learn, work, and grow together.

v1.d: Honest and responsible in both learning and working.

v2.d: Bold in trying and creating new digital solutions.

v3.d: Working together across majors and with industry partners.

v4.d: Disciplined, meticulous, and ready to meet workplace standards.
